record_title: Exact Jung-defect decomposition in constant-curvature space forms
limitations: Exact decomposition for Euclidean, spherical, and hyperbolic model spaces; spherical case is restricted to the non-antipodal Jung regime; controls active circum-support rather than whole-body Hausdorff or Banach-Mazur distance; originality is to the best of our knowledge with residual risk from Dekster 1995 and Lang-Schroeder 1997.
